newsitem.title: USA: U.S. economy's fourth-quarter growth revised down.
newsitem.headline: U.S. economy's fourth-quarter growth revised down.

text.p: Weaker inventory-building caused the U.S. economy to grow more slowly in the fourth quarter of last year than previously thought, the Commerce Department said on Friday.

The nation's gross domestic product expanded at a 3.9 percent annual rate in the three months ended Dec. 31, instead of the 4.7 percent pace estimated a month ago, the department said in its first revision of fourth-quarter national economic activity.
